title: Songs played at rent parties
summary: He names a few songs played for dancing.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Also, before we leave the rent parties, what sort of music would you play there? What kind of tunes?

No, we played songs, we'd get songs together. There was a song called, "At That Million Dollar Ball", and I remember some old songs we played, "Fiddler, Fiddle on Your Violin", and we played these songs, and there's some more of them, "When the Midnight Choo-Choo Leaves for Alabam", like that kind of and I can't remember the songs.
